info.title: Renewable Energy Forecast Analysis API
info.description:
API serving UK national wind generation actuals, decision-time forecasts at configurable cutoffs, and accuracy analytics (MAE, RMSE, bias) over January 2026. Built for a utility's day-ahead procurement team.

**Key concept:** The *decision cutoff* is the latest moment on D-1 at which forecasts are visible to the buyer. All forecast selection respects this cutoff.

get.description: Returns API status and whether the snapshot data has been loaded into memory.
Returns delivery window configuration, available cutoff times, snapshot info, and human-readable definitions of all metrics and calculations.
Returns raw actual wind generation records from the Elexon FUELHH dataset filtered by delivery date range. Useful for data transparency and debugging.

schema.title: Response Get Actuals Api Actuals Get

get.summary: Raw WINDFOR forecast series (all publish times)
get.description: Returns raw forecast records from the Elexon WINDFOR dataset filtered by target delivery date range and optionally by publish datetime range. Supports pagination via limit/offset.

schema.description: Optional publish datetime lower bound (ISO UTC)

schema.title: Response Get Forecasts Api Forecasts Get

get.description: Returns, for each target half-hour period of the delivery day, the latest forecast published at or before the specified decision cutoff on D-1. This is the key 'what did the buyer see?' endpoint.

parameters.name: cutoff

schema.description: Decision cutoff time in Europe/London on D-1 (HH:MM)
schema.title: Cutoff

parameters.description: Decision cutoff time in Europe/London on D-1 (HH:MM)

schema.title: Response Get Latest Forecasts Api Forecasts Latest Get

get.summary: Actual vs latest-at-cutoff forecast for one delivery day (E6)
get.description: Returns 48 half-hourly comparison points pairing actual wind generation with the latest forecast available at the decision cutoff on D-1. Includes summary KPIs (MAE, RMSE, bias) and an uncertainty band (± RMSE).

parameters.name: cutoff

schema.description: Decision cutoff time (HH:MM) in Europe/London on D-1
schema.title: Cutoff

parameters.description: Decision cutoff time (HH:MM) in Europe/London on D-1

get.summary: Actual vs forecast comparison over a date range (E7)
get.description: Returns comparison points for all half-hour periods in the specified delivery date range. Useful for month-view charts and scatter plots of actual vs forecast.

parameters.name: cutoff

schema.description: Decision cutoff time (HH:MM) in Europe/London on D-1
schema.title: Cutoff

parameters.description: Decision cutoff time (HH:MM) in Europe/London on D-1

get.summary: Overall accuracy KPIs for a delivery date range (E8)
get.description: Computes MAE, RMSE, bias, normalised MAE, percentiles, coverage, and extremes for the latest-at-cutoff forecasts across the specified delivery date range.
Returns MAE, RMSE, and bias broken down by individual delivery day.

get.summary: Error heatmap by delivery day × hour, plus hourly profile (E10)
get.description: Returns a heatmap of mean error and MAE for each delivery-day × hour combination, plus an hourly profile aggregated across all days in the range.

get.summary: Accuracy by forecast lead-time horizon bucket (E11)
get.description: Computes MAE, RMSE, and bias for all available forecast publish times grouped into horizon buckets. Uses ALL publish times (not only the latest-at-cutoff) to show how accuracy varies with lead time.

get.summary: Error distribution histogram and percentile summary (E12)
get.description: Returns the full error distribution as equal-width histogram bins, along with mean, P05, P50, and P95 quantiles.

post.summary: Fetch and ingest data dynamically with custom field mappings
post.description: Allows the frontend to specify API URLs or stream endpoints, date boundaries, and dynamic field names (e.g. for 'startTime', 'publishTime', 'generation') to fetch, clean, and hot-reload data into the backend.

post.summary: Re-fetch snapshot from Elexon and reload (E13)
post.description: Triggers a fresh data fetch from Elexon BMRS APIs and reloads the in-memory repository. Protected by X-Admin-Token header. Disabled if ADMIN_TOKEN is not set.
